core_obligations: The authors obtain nearly sorting-strength lower bounds by encoding ranked inputs sharing a comparison trace, analyzing subtree sensitivity, proving cross-inversion anti-concentration, and counting permutahedron components under explicit leaf-child parity conditions. The full source-local mechanisms are retained. Related tree bounds are one family, not separate parameter counts.
